sources: Drive: 馬券購入法 (オッズの断層 / 券種別控除率)
Drive: ビル・ベンター研究 (model+market combination, Harville discount)
Drive: 亀谷敬正の競馬血統辞典 同名馬統合版 (research/kametani/sire_rules.json sha256 ce869790851b37a3…)
learning_races: 2026-11-13..17 PAPER 152R (shadow_measure) - in-sample, used only to set the frozen values below
production_change: NONE. No ranking, ticket, KRS, MEC, cap, capital or Owner change. Kelly/EV stay disabled until calibration is approved.

candidates.hypothesis: Runners whose sire has a 亀谷 buy condition fully matched (and no caution matched) have a higher top-3 rate and place PFS than covered runners with no match.
candidates.control: covered_no_match runners in the same races
candidates.reject_if: at 100 matched runners the top-3 rate is not higher than control
candidates.promote_if: never automatic; at 300 runners report to the Owner as a candidate evidence feature

candidates.hypothesis: When the 2nd-favourite odds / favourite odds >= 2.5 the favourite wins at least 15 points more often than when < 2.5 (in-sample 68.5% vs 36.7%).
candidates.reject_if: at 100 races the difference is < 15 points or its 95% CI includes 0
candidates.promote_if: report to the Owner as a candidate NO-BET / axis rule

candidates.hypothesis: With frozen weights a=0.4 (model) b=0.8 (market), the combined winner probability has lower log-loss than the market alone (in-sample LODO 1.6065 vs 1.6111).
candidates.primary_metric: winner log-loss: combined vs market vs model
candidates.promote_if: only a calibration-candidate report; formal EV/Kelly stay forbidden without a separate Owner approval

candidates.hypothesis: Benter's discounted Harville (0.81 / 0.65) gives lower log-loss for the observed 2nd and 3rd than plain Harville, for the model probabilities.
candidates.promote_if: report to the Owner as a candidate for P2/P3 ordering research
